title: Iran threatens to target homes of US and Israeli officials in the region
byline: Ebrahim Zolfaghari, the spokesperson for Iran’s Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters - the country’s highest operational command unit coordinating the armed forces - has threatened that the armed forces will target the houses of US and Israeli ‘‘commanders and political officials in the region."

title: Iran and US ‘expressed confidence’ in Pakistan talks
byline: Pakistan’s foreign minister says both Iran and the US have ‘‘expressed confidence in Pakistan to facilitate’‘ talks.

title: Notorious gang member ‘Midigama Chuti’ brought back to Sri Lanka
byline: Prabhath Madusanka, also known as ‘Midigama Chuti,’ a member of an organized criminal gang who was taken into custody in Oman, has been brought back to the country this morning (30).

title: Trump says US could ‘take oil in Iran’ and seize Kharg Island
byline: Donald Trump has told the Financial Times he could ‘‘take the oil in Iran’’ and possibly seize the country’s major fuel hub of Kharg Island.

title: Oil prices jump after Yemeni Houthis attack Israel, widening Iran conflict
byline: Oil prices extended gains on Monday after Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis launched over the weekend their first attacks on Israel since the ⁠start of the U.S.-Israel war with Iran, widening the conflict in the Middle East.

title: Warm weather conditions expected to continue over the island
byline: Warm weather conditions prevailing over the island are expected to continue, today (30) the Department of Meteorology said.
